api_changes.detail: The quickstart shows POST https://api.together.ai/v1/chat/completions and an OpenAI client base_url of https://api.together.ai/v1. This sample only changes the model field.
The deprecations page says these models can no longer be used as a base model for a fine-tuning job. This row is the fine-tuning service, not serverless inference.

code_change.before:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.together.ai/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-131k-Instruct-Reference",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
